purpose: Client-side searchable dropdown multi-select for enum-safe admin form values.
businessRules: Submitted values are normalized through src/lib/admin-enums.ts before entering server actions.
Use for SKU-adjacent tags, product badges, and asset tags where values must be uppercase and contain only A-Z, 0-9, hyphen, or underscore.
When valueKind is tag, typed values are capped to the shared 40-character asset-tag contract and the selected set is capped to 16 tags.
Do not use this component for backend category family keys or product type keys that intentionally preserve backend catalog key casing.
